# API Contract Checklist: Vender tokens de un jugador (SPEC-011)

**Purpose**: Evaluar la calidad de los requisitos del contrato HTTP de SPEC-011: completitud, claridad, consistencia y cobertura de respuestas y errores, para las cinco rutas nuevas y para la variante secundaria de la ruta existente.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [contracts/listings.md](../contracts/listings.md) · [contracts/buy-listing.md](../contracts/buy-listing.md) · [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Contract Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are all five new routes specified with method, path, authentication requirement and a documented successful response? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the existing purchase route documented for both modes, with the field that distinguishes them and the behaviour of each combination? [Completeness, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the request fields of the publication route specified with type, obligation and validation rules, including the strict integer rule for `quantity`? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md; Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 - Are all fields of the publication representation specified, including their types, units and nullability in the detail response? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK005 - Is documented that the creation route of the listing resource does not exist, so that no client infers an alternative way to publish? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md; Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the response shapes of the three read routes defined explicitly, including the envelope used for collections? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md]

## Contract Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the accepted set of values for the status filter defined exhaustively, with the capitalisation requirement stated as an obligation rather than an example? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md; Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the behaviour stated when the status filter carries an unrecognised value, and is it distinguished from an empty result? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK009 - Are the monetary units of every amount in the request and response stated, so that no field can be read in an ambiguous unit? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the rule that the requested `listingId` must be a strict JSON integer, with the rejected representations enumerated, stated without relying on behaviour inherited from another endpoint? [Clarity, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the status code of a successful publication specified unambiguously, and is it justified against the convention used by the existing routes? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the meaning of `closedAt` and its nullability specified for each possible state of the publication? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md]

## Contract Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Are the same error codes used for the same condition across the contracts and the functional requirements, without synonyms or near-duplicates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the rule that the ownership requirement is enforced only by the owner in the detail and cancellation routes stated consistently between the two? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the behaviour of the detail route consistent with the behaviour of the purchase route when the publication is not visible to a third party? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the fields shared between the request and the response of the purchase route consistent, including the optionality of the publication identifier in each direction? [Consistency, contracts/buy-listing.md; Spec §FR-013, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the prohibition on revealing data consistent between what the requirements forbid and what the contracts promise not to reveal? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033; contracts/listings.md; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the documented status of a publication consistent between the route that returns a single publication and the routes that return collections? [Consistency, contracts/listings.md]

## Error Response Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Is a response specified for every documented rejection reason, without a rejection described in the requirements that has no documented response? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-018, §FR-019, §FR-021, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the distinction between a malformed request and a structurally valid request that fails a business rule documented, so that the two are not conflated? [Clarity, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK021 - Is documented that the internal failure response is generic and does not expose technical identifiers, consistently across routes? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the response for a publication that is not visible to the requester documented as indistinguishable from one that does not exist, as an obligation and not only as an outcome? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md; Spec §FR-019, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the error structure required for the whole API documented in these contracts, so that the new routes do not define a variant? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 - Are documented examples or tables covering the combination of a publication state with the identity of the requester for the detail route? [Coverage, contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK025 - Are documented examples covering the publication with a body that mixes fields from both purchase modes? [Coverage, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the documented repeated purchase of an already purchased publication specified, and is its difference from the direct purchase behaviour made explicit? [Coverage, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK027 - Are the documented outcomes of simultaneous attempts expressed as requirements, or only as observed behaviour of the underlying mechanism? [Coverage, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the effect of expiry documented on each of the four routes, given that expiry is derived and not stored? [Coverage, contracts/listings.md; Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK029 - Is documented what the cancellation route returns, rather than leaving the successful response undefined? [Completeness, contracts/listings.md]

## Compatibility with the Existing Contract

- [x] CHK030 - Is documented that the direct purchase mode preserves the existing request and response contract, including the fields it must keep? [Completeness, contracts/buy-listing.md; Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK031 - Is the obligation that the direct purchase validation is not weakened documented explicitly, rather than inferred from the absence of change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK032 - Are the changes to the existing purchase contract identified as additive, with no existing field renamed, retyped or removed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the relation between the error codes of the existing purchase contract and those introduced by this feature documented, so that overlapping meanings can be detected? [Consistency, contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK034 - Is documented which specification owns each part of the shared route, to avoid two specifications defining the same operation? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012; specs/010-buy-tokens/contracts/buy-tokens.md]

## Traceability and Documentation

- [x] CHK035 - Is every error code introduced by this feature traceable to a functional requirement or an approved clarification? [Traceability, Spec §FR, §CL]
- [x] CHK036 - Is every documented response field justified by a requirement that demands that data, without fields included only by convenience? [Traceability, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK037 - Is the requirement to document the new surface in the generated API description present as an obligation, and is the set of operations it covers identifiable? [Traceability, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK038 - Is documented which routes are read-only and which mutate state, so that the idempotency discussion is unambiguous? [Clarity, contracts/listings.md]
